findings.observation: Original-resolution inspection shows exactly one adult woman with one coherent body and no duplicated anatomy.
The subject and extremities appear complete with margin, but the provider raster is 1023x1537 rather than the contract-required 1024x1536 canvas, so the presentation gate cannot pass.
Visible brush planes across skin, hair, fabric, and parchment staging read as cinematic semi-realistic painting rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

The body, face, hair, palette, longcoat, fitted shoes, and wooden comb are legible, but the small tattoo is placed on the side of the neck rather than the nape and multiple decorative braid cuffs exceed the one-detail manifest.
The mouth is closed and unsmiling; the gaze and brow remain calm and restrained.
The figure remains a grounded ordinary mortal with no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, affinity cue, glow, frame, star, UI, logo, watermark, or text.

The heart-shaped face, narrow lanky body, high gathered mass of many thin copper locs, tailored longcoat, and keepsake-touch pose are distinct from the reference identity and its single heavy side braid.
